issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כִּי יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָוֶן' means 'that they would turn back from iniquity' (positive: they will return from evil). The Chinese '他們必不轉離虛空' adds a negation '不' and changes 'מֵאָוֶן' (from iniquity) to '虛空' (vanity/emptiness), reversing the meaning: it says they will not turn away from vanity, whereas the Hebrew says they will turn away from iniquity.
